predictions: Hey, 19-6 last week ties for my best week of the season so far! (And yeah, it's actually a little sad that I haven't been able to pull off even one 20-win week… but if C would just f-the-f-off that would certainly make things a whole lot easier…) Anyway, that brings me to 152-71 (68.2% correct) for the season so far, and I've finally at least started hitting on some of the G matches. I kinda think Menace 2 Sobriety is some sort of honorary C team, as I can't figure them out either.

Match of the week: (G Div.) Dart Knights @ The Dartifacts. Ok, time for the next round in the four-team battle royale known as the G division title chase. What makes this race extra interesting is that the two teams one match off the pace both have more points than the teams they are chasing. So each head-to-head really is for the current hold of a spot, even when the records don't initially match. This was Dartifacts' worst matchup so far, but they figure it out… 'Facts, 13-11.

Match #2: (B Div.) Consistently Inconsistent @ Hump Day! The odds of anyone catching Darty are somewhere between "not today, Satan" and "what are you smoking?" But the race for 2nd (and the likelihood of a climb to the league's top division!) is super duper still on. A three-team rager continues for that spot, and here are two of that trio. I'll take Inconsistent here, but do so a bit hesitantly. 14-10.

Match #3: (F Div.) Bottoms Up @ That's What She Said. Bottoms Up is on a six-match run and the F race is in their control. But man, oh man, do they feel the need to make every last damn thing interesting. It really is ok to list strong, put a team under, and then just coast to a win. But they do that rarely. They win again, late again, sigh, 13-11.

Match #4: (A Div.) Lunatic Fringe @ Dart Attack. With Fringe taking one on the chin last week, Dart Attack's fall in a 1001 that they super had is doubly painful. Had Attack finished that off, this pairing would be for 2nd in A, and that is some seriously rarified air, people. Alas, it's not, and alas, Fringe got its wake-up call. So this is Fringe, 15-9.

Match #5: (C Div.) Mulligan's Mafia @ Village Idiots. The Outlaws have been anything but truly dominant, but they probably have enough wins to start salting away the C crown. Which means the real story is the fight for 2nd, and that falls squarely on the shoulders of these two. How do they both have losing DCkt records? Mafia, 13-11.

Matches #6 & #7: (D Div.) Liquor Possee @ Red-eye Rangers; Menace 2 Sobriety @ Dart Side of the Moon. The middle four in D have records and point totals so similar that if they weren't looking at the standings themselves, I'm betting every team in this quartet would believe they were whatever total you told them was them. And now the quartet tangles to sort stuff out… Rangers take out the Posse again, 14-10; but Menace flips their terrible loss, 13-11.

Match #8: (C Div.) Nine Lives @ Off Constantly-Reboot. Well, somebody in C will end up in D next season. Is it the loser here? Is it both of this pair? I think Off Constantly win a third straight, 13-11.

Match #9: (A Div.) Why So Serious? @ Show Me Your Tips. Show Me got the marquee win last week, and has now won 3 of the last 4. Last time around, Serious dropped them in 1001, in the main reason Show Me isn't fighting for 2nd now. Show Me gets payback, 14-10.
Match #10: (E Div.) Cheap Shots @ She-nanigans. Looking like a three-team battle to avoid the despised 'bottom-two' slots in E this season, so this matchup could really be huge. Cheapies it is, 15-9.
Match #11: (E Div.) Death Throw @ Bangin The Wire. It's really not very far from these teams to 2nd place (and a likely climb to D). DT just has to learn how to play 301 eventually, right? DT, 14-10.

Match #12: (G Div.) Triple Shot @ 21 Dart Salute. Eek, is this the first recognizable pairing in the fight to determine "that spot"? I'm thinking Salute escapes this particular discussion. Salute, 14-10.
And the remaining 13 matches, sorted by division:
A Division: Brave the Elements 18, Double In Stumble Out 6.
B Division: Darty 16, McGavin 8; Raging 15, Sam's Brother's Tab 9.
C Division: The Outlaws 15, One Armed Bandits 9.
D Division: Rif Raf 14, Irish Ton 10; Wing 16, Ton 80 Proof 8.
E Division: Rippin Darts 14, Machine 10; Dirty Darts 15, Corks 9.
F Division: Duck Duck Groove 14, Shark Shooters 10; Nein Mark 13, Sofa Kings 11; Armed & Hammered 16, Coach 8.
G Division: Your 6 15, Bright side 9; Dartness 15, We Throw It 9.
